sources.entry: Kawa - Better input source switcher for OS X. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/utatti/kawa) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Kawa is a macOS input source switcher that lets you assign your own keyboard shortcuts to switch between input sources.
summary.what_it_does: Kawa is a macOS app for switching keyboard input sources using user-defined shortcuts. The README describes it only at this high level, with no further feature list. It can be installed via Homebrew Cask or by downloading prebuilt binaries from the Releases page and moving Kawa.app into Applications. The README notes a known macOS Carbon library bug: switching with TISSelectInputSource does not work well with complex CJKV input sources. For development, the project uses Carthage for dependencies and is opened in Xcode. The project is released under the MIT License.
use_cases: switch keyboard layouts with a shortcut on macOS
change input method quickly while typing
switch between multiple languages on a Mac
install a macOS input source switcher via Homebrew
how_to_run: Alternatively: download Kawa.zip from Releases, unzip, and move Kawa.app to Applications
carthage bootstrap, then open the project in Xcode
notable: User-defined keyboard shortcuts for switching input sources
caveats: Known macOS Carbon bug: switching to complex CJKV input sources via TISSelectInputSource does not work well
Development build requires Carthage and Xcode
